name: 11x
tagline: Autonomous AI sales reps that prospect and book meetings
description: 11x deploys autonomous "AI workers" — Alice (SDR) and Mike (voice) — that find prospects, run multichannel outbound, qualify leads, and book meetings on a human rep's behalf. Built for revenue teams that want to scale outbound without proportionally scaling headcount.
pricingDetails: Enterprise pricing — custom annual contracts based on volume of leads.
